topic.title: Stock market crash: Terrible Thursday for Sensex, Nifty as over  ₹7 lakh cr investors' wealth eroded - what went wrong?
topic.source_snippet: The Indian stock market plunged on October 8, with Nifty down 1.11% and Sensex falling nearly 700 points. Factors include rising repo rates, foreign selling, and inflation concerns, resulting in over 7 lakh crore loss in market capitalisation.

The Indian stock market plunged on October 8, with Nifty down 1.11% and Sensex falling nearly 700 points. Factors include rising repo rates, foreign selling, and inflation concerns, resulting in over 7 lakh crore loss in market capitalisation.

news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: On October 8, the Indian stock market experienced a sharp decline, with the Nifty falling 1.11% and the Sensex dropping nearly 700 points.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Does a single-day market crash mean my long-term investment strategy is broken?
news_analysis.institutional_reality: Market volatility is currently being driven by macroeconomic pressures including rising repo rates, persistent inflation concerns, and significant foreign institutional selling.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Review your asset allocation against your original investment horizon rather than reacting to short-term market fluctuations caused by external macroeconomic factors.

stat_data.label: Wealth Erosion
stat_data.context: October 8-la market-oda total market capitalisation-la 7 lakh cr varai loss aagiruku. Idhu oru single day-la nadantha periya impact.

flowchart_data.text: Rising Repo Rates: Interest rates high-a irukkurathu market-ku pressure.
Inflation Concerns: Prices yerurathu company profit margins-a affect pannuthu.
Foreign Selling: FIIs heavy-a sell pannurathu market-a down pannuthu.

slides.title: Myth vs Reality
slides.myth: Market crash aagum bodhu ellam sell panni exit aagidalam.
slides.reality: Short-term volatility-a paathu panic aagi sell pannurathu, long-term wealth creation-a spoil pannidum.
slides.card_text: Market crash aagum bodhu ellam sell panni exit aagidalam. Short-term volatility-a paathu panic aagi sell pannurathu, long-term wealth creation-a spoil pannidum.

slides.title: SIP investors-ku idhu bad news-a?
slides.card_text: Illave illai! SIP-la market drop aagum bodhu, ungaluku adhigamaana units kidaikum. Idhu 'Rupee Cost Averaging' nu solluvanga, long-term-la idhu nallathu.

checklist_data.text: Stick to your original investment horizon.

slides.title: Golden Rule for Investors
slides.card_text: Market volatility-a paathu bayapadama, unga goals-ku ethamaari portfolio-va review pannunga. Macroeconomic factors-ala varura fluctuations temporary-nu purinjikonga.

slides.title: Ippo enna pannanum?
slides.cta_detail: Ippo unga portfolio-va check panni, unga original investment goal-oda align aagi irukka nu paarunga. Save pannikonga, market volatility-la panic aagum bodhu idha marakkama read pannunga!
